text:
# Me, looking at Harel's page

## 1. What I'd do, and how sure I am

I'd move my money into the S&P 500 track (**"עוקב מדד S&P 500"**). It's the thing I'd already heard of, and on this page it has the best 5-year number in almost every product. In every product it's around 11.8–11.9% a year over 5 years and around 13.7% over 3 years. Most other tracks I saw are in the 2–9% range. Only the share-heavy tracks (**"מניות"**) come close, and only some of them.

The fee rows I'd look at for the S&P 500 track:
- **"קופת גמל להשקעה"**: 0.56% **"מהחיסכון"**, 0% **"מההפקדות"**, 13.7% over 3 years, 11.92% over 5 years.
- **"קרן השתלמות"**: 0.5% from savings, **"אין"** (none) from deposits, 13.71% and 11.89%. It holds **"7.9 מיליארד ₪"**, so lots of people are in it, which reassures me.
- **"קרן חדשה מקיפה"** (pension, I think): 0.16% from savings, but 1.47% from deposits.

**How sure am I?** About 60% sure about choosing the S&P 500 track. Only about 30% sure I'm doing it in the right place. The page never tells me which of these products *my* savings are actually in, so I'd have to call Harel or check my payslip first.

## 2. Parts I actually used
- The title **"הראל"** and the line right under it saying fees are what was really charged in 2025.
- The row of buttons under **"כל המוצרים של הראל"**, mainly to see what products exist (I recognised **"קרן השתלמות"**, **"קופת גמל להשקעה"** and **"קרן חדשה מקיפה"**).
- The big table: the track names, the fee column and the return column.
- The grey heading bars for each product, e.g. **"קרן השתלמות 16 מסלולים · דמי ניהול מהחיסכון: מ־0.41% עד 0.67%"**. These were useful as a quick summary.
- The sentence under the table: **"התשואה היא תשואת עבר… לפני דמי הניהול ולפני מס"**.

## 3. Block by block
- **Top menu** (**"מדריך"**, **"השוואה למטרה"**…): skipped. I'm here for Harel.
- **Title and intro text**: used it. **"123 מקור · 123 מחושב"** confused me. I didn't get what clicking a number would show me, so I ignored it.
- **"כולל את החברות: הראל פנסיה וגמל… הראל קרנות נאמנות"**: skimmed it.
- **The product buttons**: used them to see what exists. But the button says **"כל המוצרים 105"** and the text below says **"96 מסלולים ב־7 מוצרים"**. I count 9 buttons, so which number is right?
- **The main table**: used it, but it is *very* long. I scrolled through about 9 screens of rows that look almost the same. Inside each product the order is by fee, so the S&P 500 track was in a different place each time and I had to hunt for it.
- **The grey product bars**: used them. They told me which product I was in, until they scrolled away. Then I lost track (around screens 4–5 I wasn't sure if I was still in **"קרן השתלמות"** or something else).
- **"תגמולים ואישית לפיציים"**: confused me. I have no idea what that is or whether it's mine.
- **"חיסכון לכל ילד"**: skipped. I don't have kids.
- **"מרכזית לפיצויים"**: skipped. I don't know what it is.
- **The notes at the bottom of the table** (**"אין: בסוג הקופה הזה מותר לגבות…"**, **"PF-06"**, **"PF-10"**): skimmed. The codes mean nothing to me.
- **"קרנות מחקות"** and **"קרנות סל"**: confused me. The S&P 500 options here (**"הראל מחקה S&P 500 (4D)"**) look much cheaper: **"0% קבועים, 0.1% משתנים, 0.025% נאמן"**. But I don't know if those are the same kind of thing as my savings, or if I can even move my money there.
- **"מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל"** (the list you open with arrows): skipped. It looks like legal documents.
- **"לא מצאתם שם?"** (the search box): skipped. I'd only need it if the name in my app is different.
- **Footer**: skipped.

## 4. In the tables
- **What I looked at:**
  - **"המסלול"**: the names. I searched for **"S&P 500"** and **"מניות"**.
  - **"דמי ניהול… מהחיסכון"**: the top number.
  - **"תשואה שנתית ממוצעת"**: I mostly compared the **"5 שנים"** line, because it's the longer period.
  - **"כסף מנוהל"**: only to feel safe ("a lot of money is there").
- **What I ignored:**
  - **"קופה"**: the numbers like 15283 and the little icon next to them.
  - The **"מההפקדות"** line. I noticed it was 0% or **"אין"** almost everywhere, and only paid attention when it jumped to 1.47%.
  - The **donut charts**, and the **teal and yellow dots** for **"מניות"** and **"מט"ח"**. I don't know what a full yellow ring is supposed to tell me.
  - The small **sort arrows** next to the headings.
  - The **coloured tags** in the fund tables: **"צוברת"**, **"חשיפה לדולר"**, **"כמה דרכים יחד"**, **"מס גם על שינויי המטבע"**.
- **"פחות מ־3 שנים"**: half the rows say this instead of a number. I took it to mean "too new, no result", so I ignored those tracks.

## 5. What I didn't understand
- What **"מהחיסכון"** vs **"מההפקדות"** means in real money. Is 0.16% + 1.47% cheaper or more expensive than 0.56% + 0%?
- **"אין"** vs **"0%"**: are they the same thing?
- **"מט"ח"**, and why a track can be 99% shares and 99% foreign currency at the same time.
- **"לפני דמי ניהול"**: so do I subtract the fee myself to get my real return?
- **"קבועים / משתנים / נאמן"**, **"4A / 4D"**, and **"צוברת"**.
- **"עוד לא דווח"**, **"הלכה יהודית"** (I guessed it's religious), **"גמיש"** and **"קיימות"**.
- What makes **"תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים"** or **"מרכזית לפיצויים"** different from the others.

## 6. What I wanted and couldn't find
- **Which product I actually have.** Pension? Training fund? Both?
- **What these fees mean in shekels for me**, e.g. "on ₪50,000 you'd pay about ₪X a year".
- **How to switch tracks**, and whether switching costs money or triggers tax.
- **Can I move my savings into the cheap S&P 500 funds** under **"קרנות מחקות"**, or is that a completely different thing?
- **A simple way to see just the S&P 500 track** in every product side by side, without scrolling through all the rows.
- **What happened in bad years.** The page shows averages only, so I can't see how much it dropped at its worst.

## 7. If half the page had to go
1. **"מה כתוב במסמכים של הראל"** (the documents list).
2. **"חיסכון לכל ילד"** and **"מרכזית לפיצויים"**.
3. The **donut charts** and the **"מניות / מט"ח"** percentages.
4. The **"קופה"** number column, and the **PF-06 / PF-10** notes.
5. All the tracks that say **"פחות מ־3 שנים"** on both lines. They give me nothing to compare.
6. The **"לא מצאתם שם?"** search box and **"123 מקור / 123 מחושב"**.

I'd keep the names, the fee from savings, the 5-year return, and the grey product bars.
